help.subtitle: Usage guide for staff
help.statusPendingNext: Secretary/Vice Secretary reviews and passes or rejects it

help.statusApprovedNext: Process complete — applicant already received the file by email

help.workflowSecretaryStep1: Open "Pending Review" from the left menu
help.workflowSecretaryStep2: Open the document file and check it for accuracy
help.workflowSecretaryStep3: If correct, click "Send to President" — if not, click "Reject" with a reason
help.workflowSecretaryStep4: The system verifies your identity and records your name automatically — no need to type it
help.workflowPresidentStep1: Open "Pending Signature" from the left menu
help.workflowPresidentStep2: Open the file, sign it outside the system (pen or digital signature), save as PDF
help.workflowPresidentStep3: Click "Approve & Issue Document Number" and attach the signed file — the system issues the number and notifies the applicant automatically
help.faqQ1: I don’t see documents in my queue — what do I check?
help.faqA1: Confirm your email is listed in the "เจ้าหน้าที่" sheet tab with the correct role (secretary, vice_secretary, president, vp_internal, vp_external)
help.faqQ2: I approved/advanced a document but the applicant says they got no email — what now?
help.faqA2: Check that the "อีเมล" column for that row in the sheet is filled in correctly. If the button showed an amber warning, it already means no recipient email was found — notify them directly
help.faqQ3: What does an "unauthorized attempt" email or LINE message mean?
help.faqA3: It means someone tried to review or approve a document, but their email or claimed position didn’t match the staff database. The system takes no action on that document automatically — worth checking who attempted it and why
help.faqQ4: A document was rejected and the applicant wants to resubmit — what do they do?
help.faqA4: They can click "Resubmit document" directly in the rejection email — the system auto-fills their previous details, no need to re-enter everything
help.guideBannerText: Step-by-step instructions with screenshots for every role are in the User Guide

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: For applicants
faq.q1: I submitted a document — how long until it’s processed?
faq.a1: Normally no more than 3 working days from the date you submit, covering both the secretary’s review and the president’s approval. You’ll get an email whenever the status changes, and you can check the status yourself anytime on the status page.
faq.q2: I forgot my Tracking ID — what do I do?
faq.a2: Your Tracking ID is in the confirmation email sent when you submitted. If you submitted while signed in with Google, you can also find it on "My Documents"
faq.q3: My document was rejected — what does that mean and what do I do?
faq.a3: It means something needs fixing before it can move forward. The rejection email states the reason and includes a "Resubmit document" link — clicking it auto-fills your previous details, no need to re-enter everything
faq.q4: What file format do I need to attach?
faq.q5: Once approved, how do I get the final document?
faq.a5: You’ll get an email with the document number and a link to the signed document. You can open it again anytime on "Check Status" or "My Documents"
faq.q6: I made a typo after submitting — can I fix it?
faq.a6: You can’t edit it yourself once submitted — please contact the secretary directly for help
faq.q7: Can I use my university email (.ac.th) to submit?
faq.a7: Yes, but it must be a Google account, since the system uses Google permissions to grant file access. Students with ID 68 or earlier can use @student.mahidol.edu right away. Students with ID 69 onwards using @student.mahidol.ac.th must first register for Google Workspace with the university, and it becomes usable the next working day (see the IT Division website for registration steps). If you haven’t registered yet or need to submit immediately, use a personal Gmail instead.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: The information entered into this document submission system is personal data collected by the Engineering Student Association, Mahidol University, as follows:
privacy.section2Body: The Engineering Student Association Document Submission System, Mahidol University, collects, stores, uses, and applies limitations on the use or disclosure of personal data in order to carry out the document review and approval process, notify applicants of document status, and to enable contact should there be any questions regarding a submitted document.
privacy.section3Title: 3. Your rights regarding your personal data
privacy.section3Item1: The right to withdraw consent, and the right to access your personal data
privacy.section3Item2: The right to request the transfer of your personal data
privacy.section3Item3: The right to object to the collection, use, or disclosure of your personal data
privacy.section3Item4: The right to request deletion of your personal data
privacy.section3Item5: The right to request suspension of use of your personal data
privacy.section3Item6: The right to request correction of your personal data
privacy.section3Footer: You may request the deletion or destruction of your personal data, except where the Association is required to retain such data to comply with a relevant process or law (for example, documents that have already been issued an official document number and approved).
privacy.section4Body: Only you (the document owner) and staff involved in the approval process. Every file is shared with specific individuals only — never a public link.
privacy.section5Body: To exercise any of the rights listed in Section 3, or if you have questions about your personal data, please contact us via the email shown at the bottom of every page on this site.
privacy.referenceText: Mahidol University Announcement on Personal Data Protection Policy B.E. 2563
